log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Use Raichu/Garchomp to immediately deny or punish Archaludon while preserving Garchomp’s Ground pressure. Goodra-Hisui is the rain-stable pivot; intended Mega Charizard Y is a protected late-game weather overwrite and Grass pressure piece after Politoed or Archaludon is weakened.

Lead Grimmsnarl+Archaludon. Fake Out (+3 pri) flinches Venusaur before Sleep Powder; Archaludon Draco Meteor hits Zard-Y for 55-117% (possible OHKO). If Zard-Y survives, Heat Wave threatens but Garganacl back has Purifying Salt (sleep immune) + Wide Guard (blocks Heat Wave/Rock Slide) + Salt Cure (4x SE on Zard-Y, 40-135%). Noivern Focus Sash+Draco Meteor at 192 Spe cleans once sun drops. Drop Politoed—Drizzle overridden by Drought. No Mega on my side; opponent's is Zard-Y.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: dropped Politoed (Drizzle always overridden by Zard-Y Drought on mega evo turn 1; Weather Ball useless without rain). Grimmsnarl Fake Out (+3 pri) is the only tool to prevent Venusaur Sleep Powder on turn 1 since Chlorophyll Venusaur in sun outspeeds entire team. Garganacl Purifying Salt = hard Sleep Powder immunity switch-in; Salt Cure 4x SE on Zard-Y (40-135%, potential OHKO). Wide Guard blocks Heat Wave and Rock Slide spread. Archaludon Draco Meteor does 55-117% to Zard-Y but SpA drops -2 after; plan to switch out to reset or finish with Noivern. Noivern 192 Spe outspeeds Zard-Y (132-167) and Garchomp (134-169) outside sun; Focus Sash+Draco Meteor is endgame cleaner. If opponent brings Raichu, LightningRod only affects Electro Shot (not Draco Meteor); Raichu Fake Out is faster than Grimmsnarl and can disrupt lead. Opponent may repeat game-1 bring (Zard-Y/Venusaur/Talonflame/Garchomp) since they won.

decisions.rationale: Raichu’s faster Fake Out prevents Grimmsnarl’s disruption or screens. Garchomp then threatens the immediate Life Orb STAB Ground KO on Archaludon before it can attack. This is strongest into the displayed lead; an Archaludon Protect or Ground-immune switch still leaves Grimmsnarl flinched and preserves initiative.
decisions.notebook: Noivern is Timid Focus Sash with Hurricane, Draco Meteor, Super Fang, Protect, and Infiltrator; break Sash before relying on a late-game KO. Garganacl is Careful Leftovers with Rock Slide, Wide Guard, Salt Cure, Protect. Archaludon is Modest Life Orb Stamina with Draco Meteor, Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Protect; preserve Ground pressure. Politoed is Bold Sitrus with Weather Ball, Ice Beam, Helping Hand, Protect. Drizzle plus Rock Slide makes Mega Charizard Y a questionable primary plan.

decisions.rationale: Goodra-Hisui is the safer replacement into Archaludon and Grimmsnarl, avoids immediately exposing Charizard to the opponent’s available Politoed rain mode, and retains Charizard as a later Mega option.

Draco Meteor guaranteed OHKOs Garchomp. Fake Out Garchomp (+3 pri) flinches it before any attack. If Raichu Fake Outs Grimmsnarl, Archaludon still Draco Meteors Garchomp for the KO (Garchomp Rock Slide does 0.5x to Archaludon). If Raichu Fake Outs Archaludon, Grimmsnarl flinches Garchomp instead—both foes neutralized. Only bad case is Raichu FO Grimmsnarl + Garchomp Protect, requiring perfect prediction; even then no SpA drop so Archaludon can retry next turn.

Archaludon Draco Meteor GUARANTEED OHKO on Garchomp (114.9-255.7%) with Life Orb; no SpA drop if blocked by Protect. Opponent may repeat game-1 bring (Zard-Y/Venusaur/Talonflame/Garchomp) since they won. Raichu speed 143-178 always outspeeds Archaludon 123 at equal priority.

decisions.rationale: Encore denies Archaludon’s likely Protect by locking it back into Draco Meteor, while Flash Cannon threatens Grimmsnarl. If Grimmsnarl Fake Outs either attacker, the other line still leaves Archaludon locked and vulnerable to a cleanup Thunderbolt next turn; if it does not Fake Out Goodra-Hisui, Grimmsnarl is KOed.
decisions.notebook: No new durable opponent tendency established.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Archaludon)
decisions.rationale: Archaludon at 7%+Life Orb cannot attack without dying; switch to Garganacl who tanks Raichu Thunderbolt for 17-41%. Grimmsnarl uses Light Screen via Prankster priority, guaranteeing it lands before Goodra's Flash Cannon and halving it to survivable range. Encore risk is manageable—switch Grimmsnarl out next turn to break lock while screen persists 8 turns via Light Clay.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Archaludon Life Orb recoil kills it at low HP (10% max HP recoil). Garchomp fainted turn 1. Opponent brought Raichu+Garchomp lead; Raichu Fake Out faster than Grimmsnarl flinched it. Goodra-Hisui SapSipper switch-in after Garchomp fell. Opponent bench: Charizard-Y (Drought), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, FocusSash), Talonflame (GaleWings, MentalHerb). Noivern 192 Spe is endgame cleaner with Focus Sash+Draco Meteor. Garganacl Purifying Salt = sleep immunity, Salt Cure 4x SE on Zard-Y. Wide Guard blocks Heat Wave/Rock Slide spread. Light Clay extends screens to 8 turns. If Encored, switching out breaks the lock.

decisions.rationale: Encore denies Spirit Break and locks Grimmsnarl into its most recent Light Screen, buying a safe follow-up to remove it. Flash Cannon is the strongest listed attack into Grimmsnarl and still punishes a Grimmsnarl switch through damage on Garganacl.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Grimmsnarl has Light Clay and revealed Fake Out, Light Screen, Reflect, and Spirit Break. Garganacl revealed Rock Slide, Wide Guard, Salt Cure, and Protect; it carries Leftovers. Archaludon has Life Orb, Stamina, Draco Meteor, Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, and Protect.

decisions.rationale: Grimmsnarl is in Flash Cannon KO range; Prankster Reflect guarantees dual screens before it falls. Garganacl Salt Cures Goodra-Hisui (Steel = 1/8 HP/turn chip). Garganacl survives any single hit through Light Screen. Noivern preserved as 192-Spe endgame cleaner with Focus Sash intact.

If Encored, switching out breaks the lock. Goodra-Hisui Flash Cannon does ~46% to Grimmsnarl through Light Screen (KO at current HP). Dragon Pulse is SE on Noivern (2x). Raichu Thunderbolt is SE on Noivern (2x) but halved by Light Screen to neutral.

decisions.rationale: Noivern at 100% with Focus Sash and 192 Spe outspeeds everything on field. Light Screen (7 turns) halves incoming special hits. Archaludon at 7% with Life Orb dies to recoil on any attack — only Protect is viable, making it a wasted slot. Noivern can threaten both Raichu and Salt-Cured Goodra next turn while Garganacl tanks with screens up.

Raichu Thunderbolt is SE on Noivern (2x) but halved by Light Screen to neutral. Super Fang deals fixed 50% current HP (type effectiveness may not reduce fixed damage, only immunity blocks). Noivern Draco Meteor on Raichu: 39.5-96.3% — Sitrus Berry prevents reliable KO. Goodra Salt Cure ticks ~12.5%/turn; at 87% it needs ~5-6 turns to faint from Salt Cure alone.

decisions.rationale: Double Noivern removes Focus Sash with Raichu and then KOs with Dragon Pulse if Raichu moves first; if Noivern is faster, Goodra should still survive its resisted Draco Meteor behind Light Screen and return KO. This prevents Noivern from repeatedly pressuring Goodra while keeping Charizard for Garganacl/Archaludon.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Grimmsnarl has Light Clay; revealed Fake Out, Reflect, Light Screen, Spirit Break. Garganacl revealed Rock Slide, Wide Guard, Salt Cure, Protect, Leftovers. Archaludon has Life Orb, Stamina, Draco Meteor, Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Protect. Noivern has Focus Sash and Infiltrator; respect its broad possible Speed range.

decisions.rationale: Super Fang on Goodra is superior: fixed 43.5% (87->43.5%) with no SpA drop, better vs Protect/switch than Draco Meteor (27-55% variable + SpA drop). Light Screen keeps Noivern safe even if double-targeted (survives at 48-66%). Salt Cure on Raichu adds 1/8/turn chip on a Pokémon with no recovery. Next turn Goodra is at ~31% after Salt Cure tick, in Draco Meteor KO range.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Archaludon Life Orb recoil kills it at low HP. Garchomp fainted turn 1. Opponent lead Raichu+Garchomp; Raichu Fake Out flinched Grimmsnarl. Goodra-Hisui SapSipper switch-in after Garchomp fell. Opponent bench: Charizard-Y (Drought), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, FocusSash), Talonflame (GaleWings, MentalHerb). Noivern 192 Spe Focus Sash is endgame cleaner. Garganacl Purifying Salt = sleep immunity, Salt Cure chips 1/8/turn, Wide Guard blocks Heat Wave/Rock Slide spread. Light Clay screens active. Encore fails on targets with no move history (switch-ins). Super Fang = fixed 50% current HP, ignores type effectiveness, only immunities block. Noivern walls Charizard-Y STABs (Fire/Flying both 0.25x on Flying/Dragon) but fears Air Slash (2x on Dragon). SolarBeam is 0.25x on Noivern. Plan: chip Goodra down with Super Fang + Salt Cure, then Draco Meteor KO; Salt Cure Raichu for long-term wear; preserve Noivern SpA for endgame.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Raichu guarantees Archaludon’s KO if it does not Protect, while Goodra pressures Garganacl with its only super-effective listed attack. This covers either single Protect by removing or heavily damaging the other foe; Wide Guard does not stop either single-target move. Double Protect is the only fully defensive escape.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has Light Clay Grimmsnarl screens; Garganacl has Rock Slide, Wide Guard, Salt Cure, Protect, Leftovers, Purifying Salt. Archaludon has Life Orb, Stamina, Draco Meteor, Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Protect. Prioritize single-target attacks through screens/Wide Guard and preserve Charizard for the endgame.

decisions.rationale: Raichu Thunderbolt always KOs Archaludon at 7% through Light Screen and outspeeds, so attacking is futile — Draco Meteor at -2 SpA maxes at 36.8% vs Goodra's 37%, cannot KO. Protect (priority +4) blocks the KO. Garganacl Rock Slide chips both foes and threatens 4x on Charizard/Talonflame switch-ins. Garganacl must not Protect — Encore lock into Protect would be fatal. Salt Cure ticks continue wearing both foes.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Down 0-1 in series, game 2 turn 5. Archaludon at 7% with -2 SpA and Life Orb — any damaging move KOs it from recoil. Raichu Thunderbolt always KOs Archaludon at 7% through Light Screen (7.6-16.65% > 7%). Draco Meteor at -2 SpA does 17.6-36.8% to Goodra, cannot KO at 37%. Archaludon is a Protect bot only. Garganacl is sole win con: Rock Slide 4x on Charizard/Talonflame, Purifying Salt blocks Sleep Powder. Plan: stall with Archaludon Protect, chip with Garganacl Rock Slide + Salt Cure ticks, hope to weaken foe enough for Garganacl 1v3 endgame. Opponent bench: Charizard-Y (Drought, Heat Wave), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, FocusSash, Sleep Powder, Leaf Storm 2x on Rock but halved by Light Screen), Talonflame (GaleWings, BraveBird, Tailwind, Taunt).

decisions.rationale: Thunderbolt guarantees the KO through Light Screen if Archaludon does not land its reduced-success Protect. Goodra must Protect: it preserves the immediate win condition against Garganacl and avoids taking another Rock Slide. Encore risks leaving Archaludon alive if it attacks instead of Protecting.

Archaludon Draco Meteors Goodra — if Raichu doesn't KO it first, 79% chance to KO Goodra before it Flash Cannons Garganacl. Garganacl Rock Slide chips both foes and avoids Encore-into-Protect game-loss; Encore-into-Rock-Slide is fine vs Charizard/Talonflame 4x. Light Screen cuts Flash Cannon to 23-74%, and Goodra at 20% may self-Protect. Salt Cure ticks finish weakened Goodra.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Down 0-1, turn 6. Garganacl sole win con at 63%. Light Screen (4t) + Reflect (5t) active. Goodra-Hisui at 20% with Salt Cure+Leftovers (net -7%/turn). Raichu at 57% with Salt Cure+SitrusBerry (Sitrus triggers below 50%). Archaludon at 7% with -2 SpA + Life Orb — dead after any damaging move. Rock Slide does 5.3-18.7% to Goodra (0.5x+spread). Flash Cannon does 23-74% to Garganacl through Light Screen (2x SE). Draco Meteor at -2 does 17.6-36.8% to Goodra. Opponent bench: Charizard-Y (Drought, Heat Wave 4x resisted by Garganacl in sun?), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, Sleep Powder blocked by Purifying Salt, Leaf Storm 2x halved by Light Screen), Talonflame (Gale Wings Brave Bird, Tailwind, Taunt). Plan: KO Goodra ASAP, chip Raichu with Salt Cure, preserve Garganacl for endgame vs Charizard/Talonflame (Rock Slide 4x). Watch for Encore on Garganacl — never Protect if Encore likely.

decisions.rationale: Encore acts before Garganacl and locks its revealed last move, Rock Slide, denying Protect and Wide Guard. Flash Cannon is Goodra's strongest listed single-target option into Rock and gives the remaining Charizard the clearest forced endgame route.

Raichu must replace into Charizard; Goodra is already unable to act. Garganacl is Encore-locked into Rock Slide, so Charizard enters into a predictable but dangerous Rock attack. Preserve the immediate 1v1 and look to KO with Solar Beam/Heat Wave after Mega Evolution as appropriate.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has Light Clay Grimmsnarl screens; Garganacl has Rock Slide, Wide Guard, Salt Cure, Protect, Leftovers, Purifying Salt. Archaludon has Life Orb, Stamina, Draco Meteor, Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Protect. Garganacl can be constrained effectively with Encore, but Rock Slide remains its forced damage option. Preserve Charizard for the endgame when possible.

decisions.rationale: Rock Slide pressures both dying foes simultaneously — possible KO on Raichu (29% HP vs 21-54.8% range) and max-roll KO on Goodra (14% HP vs 6.4-14.2%). Even if Encored into Rock Slide, that's my best spammable move. Garganacl survives double-target through Light Screen (combined ~28-64%, Garganacl at 69% + Leftovers). Protect risks Encore lock; Salt Cure is redundant. Rock Slide preserves Garganacl as win con vs Charizard/Talonflame bench.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Down 0-1. Garganacl sole win con, Rock Slide 4x vs Charizard/Talonflame bench. Light Screen halves all incoming special damage. Purifying Salt blocks Sleep Powder from Venusaur. Salt Cure ticks: -12.5%/turn, +6.25% Leftovers net -6.25% for Goodra, -12.5% for Raichu (no Leftovers). Encore from Raichu is the key trap — never Protect when Encore is live. Rock Slide is safe to be Encored into. Opponent bench: Charizard-Y (Drought, Heat Wave 0.5x vs Rock through Light Screen), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, Leaf Storm neutral halved by Light Screen, Sleep Powder blocked), Talonflame (Gale Wings Brave Bird 0.5x vs Rock). Garganacl favored vs entire bench.

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolve for Drought so Solar Beam fires immediately, then target the only remaining foe. Charizard outspeeds Garganacl and must remove it before the Encore-forced Rock Slide can land.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Garganacl is Careful with Leftovers, Purifying Salt, Rock Slide, Wide Guard, Salt Cure, and Protect; it can be constrained with Encore. Grimmsnarl carries Light Clay screens. Archaludon is Life Orb Modest with Draco Meteor, Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Protect. Preserve Charizard where possible; Mega Y’s Drought enables immediate Solar Beam.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

reflections.summary: Won because the Mega Y preview plan fit the revealed Grimmsnarl/Garganacl/Archaludon/Noivern four: Charizard was preserved for the endgame and Drought-boosted Solar Beam removed Garganacl despite screens. Raichu's Encore also limited Garganacl.
reflections.adjustment: Keep Mega Y and prioritize preserving it for Garganacl; use Raichu's Encore to deny Wide Guard/Protect or lock Garganacl before committing Charizard.
reflections.notebook: Opponent brought Grimmsnarl, Garganacl, Archaludon, and Noivern in game 2. Noivern is Timid Focus Sash Infiltrator with Hurricane, Draco Meteor, Super Fang, and Protect. Garganacl can be constrained with Encore. Mega Y is a strong endgame answer to Garganacl because Drought enables immediate Solar Beam, even through the opponent's screen-oriented game plan.

reflections.summary: Garganacl was the sole win con but got Encored into Rock Slide by Raichu on turn 7, killing Raichu and Goodra but bringing in Mega Charizard-Y at 100%. Locked into Rock Slide, Garganacl couldn't Protect and was OHKO'd by a sun-boosted one-turn Solar Beam. The team preview plan was fundamentally flawed: the notebook incorrectly assessed Garganacl as favored vs Charizard-Y, when Solar Beam is 2x super effective and one-turn under Drought. The team also had no Mega evolution to match the opponent's
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring four non-Mega Pokemon against a Mega Charizard-Y sun team. If a Mega option exists on the bench, bring it. If Garganacl must be the win con, it needs Wide Guard or Protect available when Charizard-Y is in back — switch Garganacl out before Raichu can Encore, or bring a partner that can KO Raichu first. Correct the matchup chart: Garganacl loses to Charizard-Y Solar Beam, not just Heat Wave.
reflections.notebook: Series tied 1-1. Game 2 lost. Opponent bring: Charizard-Y, Garchomp, Raichu, Goodra-Hisui; benched Venusaur, Talonflame. Sun core with Raichu support (Lightning Rod, Fake Out, Encore) and Goodra-Hisui (Sap Sipper, Flash Cannon 2x vs Garganacl, Leftovers recovery). CORRECTION: Garganacl is NOT favored vs Charizard-Y — Solar Beam is 2x super effective and one-turn under Drought, OHKOs at moderate HP. Encore into Rock Slide is NOT safe when Charizard-Y waits in back. Raichu Encore is the highest-priority threat to lock down. Team had no Mega vs opponent Mega Charizard-Y — major power gap. Archaludon contributed nothing at 7% entry. Next game: consider bringing a Mega if available; if Garganacl is win con, keep Protect/Wide Guard available and eliminate Raichu before it can Encore. Goodra-Hisui is a special wall with Leftovers + Sap Sipper; needs physical pressure or Salt Cure chip. Garchomp is Life Orb Jolly with Stomping Tantrum, Dragon Claw, Rock Slide.
